title: Conversation Result v1
description: The full response body of POST /api/conversation/turn — the updated session (for the caller to carry forward on the next request) plus the turn just produced. See backend/jewelmind/conversation/schemas.py::ConversationResult and backend/jewelmind/api/routes.py::conversation_turn_route.

turn.description: The ConversationTurn just produced — see conversation-turn.schema.json. Also appended as the last element of session.turns.
